description: Revise an owned world or model preview that is ready for review, either by asset_id or by the latest preview in chat_id. mode: "auto" is the default and lets the revised preview continue to final generation; set mode: "review" only when the user explicitly asks to inspect or approve the revised preview first. Errors: INVALID_TARGET (no asset found), INVALID_STAGE (asset exists but is not preview-ready; response includes currentStatus and nextActions). Asset names are not re-derived from feedback. If your revision pivots the aesthetic significantly, supply `display_name` to rename.
name: revise_preview
title: Revise Preview
